title: Warm Turkish Lamb Lahmacun
description: A citrusy and flaky Turkish dish featuring lamb, basil leaves, and a hint of dashi extract, perfect for a quick and low-fat friendly meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the lamb mince, onion, garlic, basil leaves, dashi extract, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper, and mix well.
Divide the mixture into 4 equal parts and shape each part into a thin circle.
Place each circle on a piece of pita bread and brush the edges with olive oil.
Bake the lahmacun in the preheated oven for 12 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the lamb is cooked through.
Remove the lahmacun from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes.
Serve the lahmacun warm, garnished with additional basil leaves if desired.
Repeat the process to make the remaining lahmacun.
